notes:
Summary: Helmshore is a mid-market SaaS helpdesk provider building an AI-augmented agent and KB search feature (branded 'AnswerGrid'). They ingest product docs, release notes, and agent transcripts. Primary interest: embeddings + reranking pipeline to improve precision on short support queries and reduce false positives.

Technical profile / constraints:
- Indexing scope: moderate ~200k canonical docs + frequent delta updates (daily), expect 5-10k new docs/month.
- QPS profile: high sustained QPS for search API; target peaks 150-250 qps during business hours, baseline ~40 qps.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 120ms, 99th < 250ms for reranked top-3 results. Emphasis on tail latency.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — careful about per-query token and embedding cost; target cost per customer query < $0.003 (embeddings + model rerank).
- Model preferences: prefer open/efficient encoders (1536-d embedding target) and smaller reranker LLM for re-score (fast, quantized). Interested in Redwood recommendations for quantization & batching.
- Routing needs: multi-tenant routing, fallback to cheaper model variant at capacity thresholds, region-aware for NA residency.
- Security: SSO + SCIM, SOC2 required, audit logs, KMS integration. Data residency for primary customers in NA is a must.

CRM notes / meeting snippets:
- 2026-02-18 discovery call with Jordan (AE) + Priya (SE). CTO (Anika R.): "We need consistent top-3 accuracy for agent suggestions — can't surface hallucinations."
- 2026-02-25 sent security questionnaire and initial perf ask (ppk). Received high-level SOC2 statement; asked for KMS details.
- 2026-03-02 demo: hosted API walkthrough, streaming vs sync tradeoffs. POC scope agreed: 50 qps sustained against a subset of 40k docs + 200k-vector index.
- 2026-03-05 architecture sync: Helmshore infra team prefers managed vector store compatibility (considering Pinecone/Redis/FAISS) but wants Redwood to manage embedding lifecycle and rerank calls via hosted API.
- 2026-03-09 perf run (internal): initial runs show 95th latency ~98ms with Redwood suggestions (batching + prefix cache), 99th spiked to 280ms under synthetic tail load — flagged as blocker.

POC goals and acceptance criteria:
- Demonstrate sustained 50 qps with 95th < 120ms on rerank path for top-3 results.
- Show cost projections for 1M queries/month (embeddings + rerank) and configuration levers (batch size, quantization) to meet $0.003/query target.
- Validate routing fallback (auto to lower-cost reranker) and audit log delivery to S3/KMS.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood SE to run scaled perf sweep (Priya) with production-like dataset by 2026-03-15.
- Security: exchange KMS topology details and updated SOC attestation (inf team).
- Commercial: rough ARR estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted pricing for forecast close 2026-05.

Open questions / blockers (sales notes):
- Is Redwood hosted API able to guarantee 99th percentile SLA for rerank path (need SRE input).
- Exact data residency flow (can logs & embeddings be constrained to NA?).
- Procurement: Helmshore legal needs a vendor security pack and indemnity phone call (expected in procurement run).
